bio: Juliet Fernandez and Christine Saranilla run Juliet & Christine Mortgage under Mortgage Architects (brokerage #12728). Juliet is a licensed agent in BC and Alberta, moved from banking into mortgages in 2016 and became a full-time broker in 2023. The site offers purchase, refinance, new construction, renewals and transfers, self-employed and private lending, and quotes 1-2 day funding in Alberta.
tagline: Two Brokers. One Mission. Your Mortgage, Done Right.
